Conditions.hardware: Four NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 GPUs, 48 SMs each, virtual mesh over the existing physical ring
Conditions.cache_state: Unique prompt prefix for every timing request; cached_tokens=0 required for each sample; periodic full captures off.
Conditions.retained_features: Native virtual mesh, graph-only decode geometry, linked posting, existing B12X compute patches, SparkCache; no dynamic pressure-aware chunk sizing.
changed_variables: Eight existing runtime sources plus one new helper, ownership contract/inventory.
Candidate uses separate initially empty SparkCache root.
Rank0 reboot between the historical control and candidate arms to recover launch memory; driver/kernel, CPU governor and reported GPU application/max clocks matched peers afterward.
One initial candidate startup failed; unchanged candidate passed on retry.
Conditions.comparison: Sequential control then candidate, not interleaved; exact original source composition only, not rebuilt PR239 attribution+mHC composition.

Measurement.metric: Seconds from request submission to first nonempty streamed delta; prompt tokens / TTFT, including client/network overhead.
Measurement.clock: Windows time.perf_counter / QueryPerformanceCounter, nominal100ns clock resolution for both arms.
Measurement.warmup: Full startup/API warmup and zero running/waiting requests; one shape-warmup cycle excluded; exact token count and zero cached tokens asserted per request.
Measurement.aggregation: Median, min and max measured TTFT; throughput = tokens / median TTFT; percent =100*(control_median_TTFT/candidate_median_TTFT-1).

Conclusion: In the recorded compositions,8/16/64K prompt throughput was5.26/5.00/4.59 percent higher with sharded mHC;32/128K are candidate-only observations. Existing NCCL RS/AG carries owner-row mHC; no new native split transport was introduced.
Limitations: Sequential runs, three samples per condition, synthetic cold prompts; changed reboot/cache-root/startup history prevents a strictly isolated claim.
First launch failed in Triton load_binary during MTP W4A16 warmup before completed sharded-mHC activation; unchanged retry passed. Cause remains unresolved; no startup fix is claimed.
Alternative reduction order changes probabilities; first-token agreement on two prompts and bounded semantic checks do not establish numerical identity or comprehensive quality.
These measurements do not qualify a rebuilt PR composition that also adds attribution or other changes; that requires separate GPU/serving validation.

Correctness.activation: All4 ranks:8192 full rows,2048 owner rows,90reduce-scatter/90all-gather,zero auxiliary captures in logged calls.
